title: The team pump that kills beats the bigger creature
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): value a spell that makes lethal. P1 has seven Forests, Grizzly Bears and Llanowar Elves, and holds Preposterous Proportions (+10/+10 to its creatures) and Gigantosaurus (a 10/10 for five). P3 is at 11 with one Savannah Lions. With Proportions the Bears and Elves attack as 12/12 and 11/11: the Lions block one and the other kills P3. Gigantosaurus is the bigger card on paper but has no haste, so it kills nobody this turn. The Elves must stay untapped: the seven Forests pay for Proportions alone.

reference.analysis: Preposterous Proportions costs all seven Forests. Bears 12/12 and Elves 11/11 at P3: the single Lions blocker stops one, the other deals at least 11. Gigantosaurus instead leaves 3 power on the board this turn.

lines.label: Proportions from the Forests, both creatures at P3
lines.why: P3 is eliminated whichever creature the Lions block.

lines.label: Cast Gigantosaurus instead
lines.why: A 10/10 with summoning sickness: no kill this turn.
